decision_note: User must pick ONE idea before Codex scaffolds the project. All ideas assume UiPath Automation Cloud as the required orchestration layer and a documented Claude Code + Codex build process to claim the bonus.
shared_principles: Maestro orchestration is the spine; agents are nodes with explicit human approval gates (H1, H3).
Demo must deliberately trigger one exception and show escalation->resolution (H3).
Lead with a quantified cycle-time / cost / volume ROI claim (H2).
Keep AGENT_BUILD_LOG.md documenting Claude->Codex workflow for bonus points (H4).

ideas.name: ClaimClear
ideas.tagline: Agentic insurance-claims triage that clears the easy 80% and escalates the rest with an audit trail
ideas.problem: Insurers spend days manually triaging claims; straightforward claims wait behind complex ones. Industry cycle times of 7-15 days are common for routine auto/property claims.
ideas.target_user: Claims operations team at a mid-size P&C insurer
ideas.why_now: Maestro Case ships pre-built claims orchestration; agentic validation now reliable enough to auto-clear low-risk claims.
ideas.sponsor_api_usage: Maestro Case orchestrates: doc-intake agent (extract claim data) -> policy-coverage check (RPA bot) -> fraud/ambiguity scoring agent -> auto-pay simple cases / human-approval gate for ambiguous ones.
mvp_scope: Escalate ambiguous case to a human approval task
ideas.demo_flow: Submit a clean claim -> auto-cleared in seconds with audit trail. Submit an ambiguous claim -> agent flags low confidence -> routes to human approval queue -> human approves -> resolved.

ideas.name: DisputeDesk
ideas.tagline: Agentic loan/payment dispute resolution that cuts the resolution cycle and keeps a compliance trail
ideas.problem: Banks resolve cardholder/loan disputes in 10+ days with heavy manual back-and-forth; regulatory clocks (e.g. chargeback SLAs) add pressure.
ideas.target_user: Dispute operations team at a bank/credit union
ideas.why_now: UiPath cites Lake Michigan Credit Union pulling 10 days out of lending; the same orchestration applies to disputes.
ideas.sponsor_api_usage: Maestro Case orchestrates evidence-gathering agent + rules engine (DMN) + human adjudication gate; bot pulls transaction history, agent drafts the resolution rationale.
ideas.demo_flow: Dispute filed -> evidence auto-collected -> rules say 'borderline' -> agent drafts rationale -> human adjudicates -> decision letter generated with full audit.

ideas.name: OnboardPilot
ideas.tagline: Agentic employee onboarding that orchestrates IT, HR and access provisioning end-to-end
ideas.problem: Day-1 onboarding spans 10+ disconnected systems; new hires wait days for accounts/access, costing productivity and IT tickets.
ideas.why_now: Onboarding is a predictable sequence -> ideal BPMN; agents can resolve the exceptions (missing data, failed provisioning) that break linear automation.
ideas.sponsor_api_usage: Maestro BPMN models the order: create accounts -> provision access -> assign training -> schedule intro. Agents handle exceptions (e.g., duplicate identity) and a human gate approves privileged access.
ideas.demo_flow: New hire record submitted -> BPMN runs provisioning -> one step fails (duplicate ID) -> agent resolves -> privileged-access step pauses for human approval -> onboarding completes with timeline.
risks: Mocking many systems can look thin if not polished

ideas.name: TestPilot
ideas.tagline: Agentic test generation that turns requirements into risk-ranked test suites and flags fragile tests
ideas.problem: QA teams hand-write tests from requirements and waste cycles on flaky/fragile tests; coverage gaps slip to production.
ideas.why_now: Test Cloud was the least-crowded track in 2025 (Maestro/Agents dominated) -> lower competition; agentic requirement->test conversion is newly viable.
ideas.sponsor_api_usage: Test Cloud + agents: requirement-to-test agent generates cases, a risk-scoring agent ranks by coverage/risk, a fragility detector flags brittle tests; human reviews before commit.
mvp_scope: Fragile-test detection on a sample suite
ideas.demo_flow: Upload a requirement -> agent drafts test cases -> ranked by risk -> existing flaky test flagged -> human approves -> suite pushed to Test Cloud.

ideas.name: CareCoord
ideas.tagline: Agentic patient-care coordination that orchestrates referrals, prior-auth and follow-ups with human oversight
ideas.problem: Care coordination is exception-heavy: referrals stall, prior authorizations bounce, follow-ups slip. Manual coordination drives delays and readmissions.
ideas.target_user: Care-coordination / case-management team at a health system
ideas.why_now: UiPath names patient-care coordination as a Maestro Case use case; healthcare vertical = high judge-resonance + low competitor domain depth (our edge per CLAUDE.md strategy).
ideas.sponsor_api_usage: Maestro Case orchestrates referral intake agent + prior-auth bot + eligibility check + clinician approval gate; agents handle the exception paths (denied auth, missing records).
ideas.demo_flow: Referral arrives -> eligibility auto-checked -> prior-auth denied -> agent drafts appeal + reroutes -> clinician approves next step -> follow-up scheduled, full timeline shown.
risks: Healthcare realism needs care + clear synthetic-data disclosure

recommendation.rationale: ClaimClear maximizes judging_fit (Maestro Case ROI narrative, named UiPath use case, clean exception+governance demo) at the best feasibility for a ~19-day window. Strong, safe pick.
recommendation.high_upside_rationale: TestPilot trades judge-familiarity for the lowest-competition track (Test Cloud) and highest differentiation — pick if we want a contrarian lane.
recommendation.vertical_edge_rationale: CareCoord leans on the healthcare domain-depth edge from our playbook; highest ceiling but needs careful synthetic-data handling and the most build hours.
